title: Consumer service marketplace (childcare) web-product generation policy

notBoundTo.n0-saas-design-constraints-common: Explicitly NOT applied. That policy assumes a B2B SaaS product (pricing tiers, dashboards, feature matrices, integrations). This repo is a consumer marketplace marketing site; none of those constructs exist here and a generator must not introduce them. Binding to it requires a recorded architecture decision, which has not been made.

generationRules: Pages are drawn only from the 11 templates and 28 section contracts; no pricing-table, feature-matrix, integrations, dashboard or changelog sections.
Trust and safety content (verification, background checks, press marks) is first-class and must use the pinned asset roles; never fabricate.
Copy addresses two audiences (parents, sitters); audience-landing is the only template that switches audience.
Real people, real third-party logos and operative legal text are must-not-fabricate (see assets/asset-roles.json).
The auth entry (auth-light) stays a separate design system and is never merged into the marketing namespace.

approval.note: Policy classification is defined here; a human architecture owner must still ratify it before it replaces any shared common policy. Legal/licensing sign-off remains open in registry.manifest.json approvalFlags (legalContentSignOff, assetLicensingReviewed) and blocks production use.
